description: Establish the monorepo experiment platform and the shared TypeScript backend seam. Create a pnpm workspace with a shared @agentcore2/contracts package that holds the one finding/remediation/evidence domain contract, the BackendAdapter interface (the mock <-> real AgentCore swap seam), a deterministic synthetic mock dataset sufficient to exercise thousands-of-resource UI behavior, a MockBackendAdapter, and the basic agent catalogue (5-8 planned agents). This is the foundation both Preview A and all later previews depend on. Independent of preview apps; must be completed first.
steps: Create root package.json (private, name @agentcore2/root, packageManager pnpm) with workspace scripts: build (pnpm -r build), test (pnpm -r test), lint, format. Create pnpm-workspace.yaml listing packages/* and apps/*. Create tsconfig.base.json with strict TypeScript settings (target ES2022, moduleResolution bundler/NodeNext, strict true, declaration true) that other packages extend.

Create packages/contracts as @agentcore2/contracts: package.json (type module, main/types pointing at dist, build script `tsc -p tsconfig.json`, test script `vitest run`), tsconfig.json extending the base with composite output to dist. Add vitest as devDependency.

In packages/contracts/src, define the domain contract in domain.ts: Finding (id, title, resourceId, resourceType, service e.g. S3/EC2/EBS, region, complianceStatus COMPLIANT|NON_COMPLIANT|NOT_APPLICABLE, severity CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW|INFORMATIONAL, ruleId, firstObservedAt, lastObservedAt, accountId, tags), Remediation (id, findingId, title, description, capabilityId, deterministic boolean, requiresApproval boolean, proposedActionSummary, targetResourceId), Evidence + EvidenceEvent timeline entries (id, findingId/remediationId, timestamp, kind e.g. DETECTED|EXPLAINED|FIX_PROPOSED|APPROVED|REJECTED|EXECUTED|PROVIDER_READBACK|CONFIG_CONVERGENCE|VERIFIED, actor, summary, executionId nullable), ExecutionState (executionId, status PENDING|RUNNING|SUCCEEDED|FAILED|REJECTED, mode), and a LabMode type = 'MOCK' | 'RECORDED' | 'LIVE_LAB'. Keep provider readback and config convergence as SEPARATE evidence event kinds per SPEC.md MUST.

In packages/contracts/src/adapter.ts define the BackendAdapter interface: mode(): LabMode; listFindings(query?: FindingQuery): Promise<Paginated<Finding>>; getFinding(id): Promise<Finding | null>; getRemediationForFinding(findingId): Promise<Remediation | null>; previewFix(findingId): Promise<Remediation>; requestRemediation(findingId, {approve:boolean}): Promise<ExecutionState>; getExecution(executionId): Promise<ExecutionState | null>; getEvidenceTimeline(findingId): Promise<EvidenceEvent[]>. Include FindingQuery (filters: complianceStatus, severity, service, resourceType, search, page, pageSize) and Paginated<T> types. This is the seam later swapped for a real AgentCore adapter.

In packages/contracts/src/mock/dataset.ts implement a deterministic (seeded) synthetic dataset generator that produces a large number of findings (default e.g. 5000) across multiple services/severities/compliance statuses/accounts/regions, plus per-finding evidence timelines and proposed remediations, WITHOUT any AWS calls. Use a small seeded PRNG (no heavy deps) so output is stable across runs for testable behavior.

In packages/contracts/src/mock/adapter.ts implement MockBackendAdapter implementing BackendAdapter over the generated dataset: mode() returns 'MOCK'; listFindings applies filters + pagination in memory; previewFix returns the deterministic proposed remediation; requestRemediation with approve:false returns REJECTED and appends a REJECTED evidence event with zero mutation, approve:true returns SUCCEEDED and appends EXECUTED -> PROVIDER_READBACK -> CONFIG_CONVERGENCE -> VERIFIED evidence events with a generated executionId; getExecution returns persisted ExecutionState by id.

In packages/contracts/src/agents/catalogue.ts define AgentDefinition type (id, name, domain, description, plannedRuntime 'HARNESS'|'CUSTOM', readiness 'PLANNED'|'MOCK'|'LIVE', capabilities[]) and export AGENT_CATALOGUE with the 5-8 planned agents from the Issue: S3 SSL, S3 logging, S3 backup, Security Group specialist, EBS backup specialist, Finding triage/explanation assistant, Evidence/report assistant, optional orchestration/router. All readiness 'MOCK' or 'PLANNED' at M1.
Create packages/contracts/src/index.ts re-exporting domain, adapter, mock (dataset + adapter), and agent catalogue as the public package API.

Add Vitest unit tests in packages/contracts/src/__tests__/: (a) dataset generator is deterministic and yields the expected large count with valid shapes; (b) MockBackendAdapter listFindings filtering + pagination works; (c) requestRemediation approve:false yields REJECTED with no EXECUTED event, approve:true yields the full evidence chain with separate PROVIDER_READBACK and CONFIG_CONVERGENCE events and a persisted retrievable executionId.
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm install` at repo root succeeds and links the workspace.
`pnpm --filter @agentcore2/contracts build` produces dist output with type declarations.
`pnpm --filter @agentcore2/contracts test` passes all Vitest tests including the determinism, filtering/pagination, and approval/rejection evidence-chain tests.
The mock dataset generates thousands of findings with no AWS calls and no credentials.
AGENT_CATALOGUE exports between 5 and 8 agent definitions matching the Issue's starter set.
Provider readback and Config convergence are represented as distinct evidence event kinds.
verification: Run `pnpm install` then `pnpm --filter @agentcore2/contracts build` and confirm success.
Run `pnpm --filter @agentcore2/contracts test` and confirm all tests pass.
findings:
Package name: @agentcore2/contracts (private, type: module, ESM). Import from the package root: `import { MockBackendAdapter, generateDataset, AGENT_CATALOGUE, type Finding, type BackendAdapter, type FindingQuery, type Paginated, type EvidenceEvent, type ExecutionState, type LabMode } from '@agentcore2/contracts'`. Preview apps must depend on it via workspace protocol: add "@agentcore2/contracts": "workspace:*" to their package.json dependencies. Build outputs ESM to dist/ with .d.ts declarations (main/module ./dist/index.js, types ./dist/index.d.ts). Run `pnpm --filter @agentcore2/contracts build` before consuming dist, or import src directly in Vite dev.

MockBackendAdapter: constructor `new MockBackendAdapter(options?)` where options = { size?, seed?, dataset? } (extends GenerateDatasetOptions). Default dataset size DEFAULT_DATASET_SIZE=5000, default seed DEFAULT_SEED=0x514c4142. For faster tests pass a pre-generated dataset via `generateDataset({ size, seed })`. Methods (all async except mode()): mode()=>'MOCK'; listFindings(query?: FindingQuery)=>Paginated<Finding>; getFinding(id)=>Finding|null; getRemediationForFinding(findingId)=>Remediation|null; previewFix(findingId)=>Remediation (throws if none); requestRemediation(findingId,{approve:boolean})=>ExecutionState; getExecution(executionId)=>ExecutionState|null; getEvidenceTimeline(findingId)=>EvidenceEvent[] (returns a copy).

FindingQuery filters: complianceStatus, severity, service, resourceType, search (matches title/resourceId/ruleId), page (1-based, default 1), pageSize (default 25). Paginated<T> = { items, total, page, pageSize, totalPages }.

Approval gate: requestRemediation approve:false => ExecutionState.status 'REJECTED', approved false, ONE new REJECTED evidence event, zero mutation (no EXECUTED/PROVIDER_READBACK/CONFIG_CONVERGENCE/VERIFIED). approve:true => status 'SUCCEEDED', executionId matching /^exec-\d{8}$/, appends APPROVED->EXECUTED->PROVIDER_READBACK->CONFIG_CONVERGENCE->VERIFIED (PROVIDER_READBACK and CONFIG_CONVERGENCE are SEPARATE events). Executions persisted, retrievable via getExecution. Timestamps are deterministic (no Date.now()).

Domain enums: ServiceName = S3|EC2|EBS|IAM|RDS (dataset currently emits S3/EC2/EBS); ComplianceStatus = COMPLIANT|NON_COMPLIANT|NOT_APPLICABLE; Severity = CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW|INFORMATIONAL; LabMode = MOCK|RECORDED|LIVE_LAB; EvidenceKind = DETECTED|EXPLAINED|FIX_PROPOSED|APPROVED|REJECTED|EXECUTED|PROVIDER_READBACK|CONFIG_CONVERGENCE|VERIFIED.

AGENT_CATALOGUE: 7 agents (agent-s3-ssl, agent-s3-logging, agent-s3-backup, agent-sg-specialist, agent-ebs-backup [readiness MOCK]; agent-finding-triage, agent-evidence-report [readiness PLANNED]). Each has capabilities[]; capability ids (e.g. cap-s3-enforce-ssl) match Remediation.capabilityId. Helper findCapability(capabilityId) returns { agent, capability } | null.

Dataset: DEFAULT_DATASET_SIZE=5000 findings, fully in-memory, NO AWS calls. Deterministic per (size, seed). generateDataset returns { seed, findings, remediationsByFindingId, evidenceByFindingId }.

Monorepo/build notes: pnpm 11.24 in sandbox errors on ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS. Resolved by adding onlyBuiltDependencies: [esbuild] to pnpm-workspace.yaml AND running `pnpm rebuild esbuild` once (esbuild comes in transitively via Vitest). Root .npmrc sets verify-deps-before-run=false so `pnpm --filter ... build/test` does not re-trigger the failing dep-status install check. dist/ and *.tsbuildinfo are gitignored (build artifacts, not committed). Vitest 2.1.9 config at packages/contracts/vitest.config.ts includes src/**/__tests__/**/*.test.ts. tsconfig excludes __tests__ from the build.

REVIEW FIX (2026-09-30-143740-review.md, Issue #3 / M1): (1) Idempotent remediation — MockBackendAdapter now tracks a SUCCEEDED execution per finding (succeededExecutionByFindingId). A finding with a SUCCEEDED execution is terminal: re-approving returns the original execution and appends a single explicit no-op VERIFIED event (summary marks it a no-op) instead of replaying the EXECUTED->READBACK->CONVERGENCE->VERIFIED chain; approve:false on a terminal finding also returns the standing SUCCEEDED execution with zero mutation. (2) FIX_PROPOSED now emitted — dataset seeds DETECTED->EXPLAINED->FIX_PROPOSED for NON_COMPLIANT findings (was dead in the union + color map); docs/ARCHITECTURE.md reconciled to show it in the initial pre-approval timeline. (3) Read parity — getRemediationForFinding/previewFix now return copies ({...remediation}); requestRemediation no longer mutates the stored evidence array in place (builds a new array copy). getEvidenceTimeline already copied. New contract tests: double-approve no-op, reject-after-success no-op, read-copy isolation, FIX_PROPOSED emission. Contract tests 16 -> 20. `pnpm -r build` and `pnpm -r test` both pass.
